doc: Blind rerun (I96): the E6 vocabulary holon.diagram.evidence reads (Lexicon: names, tokenize, stopwords), written from the tooling's code and the target's own names only. names: every edge kind the pass can read (CODEC, TRANS); tokenize: the identifier syntax of Solidity and Go, lower case (the one case the pass reads), every token kept whatever its length; no stopwords. It adds no vocabulary of its own: an E6 atom is a token the target code's names share.
rule: E6: the shared name tokens of two distinct parallel edges (a CODEC edge's source functions, a TRANS edge's action), each identifier split at underscores and camel-case boundaries and lower-cased
